The FlatPricingExt constructor implicitly invokes the Ownable constructor.
newOneTokenInWei parameter is consumed by FlatPricingExt.updateRate.
newOneTokenInWei parameter is written into the oneTokenInWei state variable.
updateRate reads and overwrites oneTokenInWei.
updateRate writes the oneTokenInWei state variable.
calculatePrice reads the oneTokenInWei state variable.
oneTokenInWei is the divisor of the price calculation, a divide-by-zero/overflow surface.
value parameter is consumed by FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice.
weiRaised parameter is consumed by FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice.
tokensSold parameter is consumed by FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice.
msgSender parameter is consumed by FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice.
decimals parameter is consumed by FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice.
decimals is the exponent of 10 ** decimals, an exponentiation overflow surface.
10 ** decimals is stored in the local multiplier.
value feeds the multiplication value.times(multiplier).
multiplier feeds the multiplication value.times(multiplier).
The product value.times(multiplier) is then divided by oneTokenInWei.
The multiplication result flows back as the price calculation output.
The division result is the value returned by calculatePrice.
SafeMathLibExt.times executes the multiplication operation.
Parameter a is an operand of a * b.
Parameter b is an operand of a * b.
The product a * b is assigned to the local c.
Local c is returned by SafeMathLibExt.times.
SafeMathLibExt.divides executes the division operation.
Parameter a is the dividend of a / b.
Parameter b is the divisor of a / b.
The quotient a / b is assigned to the local c.
Local c is returned by SafeMathLibExt.divides.
SafeMathLibExt.minus executes the subtraction operation.
Parameter a is the minuend of a - b.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of a - b.
The difference a - b is returned by SafeMathLibExt.minus.
SafeMathLibExt.plus executes the addition operation.
Parameter a is an operand of a + b.
Parameter b is an operand of a + b.
The sum a + b is assigned to the local c.
Local c is checked with assert(c >= a) and returned by plus.
FlatPricingExt.calculatePrice invokes the SafeMathLibExt.times library function for the multiplication.
